subject: Generic MASTER autocoding template
batchGoal: Use this generic template only as a base. Every real task must create a feature-specific artemis-templates/<feature-name>-master-batch.json overlay.
scope: Discovery, implementation, verification, repair, and handoff.
sequencingRule: Execute batches in listed order. Do not start batch N+1 until batch N has fully passed verification.
failPolicy: Run targeted FIX -> RETEST loops for ordinary failures until all required deliverables pass or a true approval/secret/access/external/platform blocker is reached.

deliverablesCompletionMatrix.deliverable: Feature-specific MASTER template is created before implementation.
Implementation updates the required frontend, backend, docs, tests, and config surfaces.
Verification passes or reports an exact approval/external blocker.

batches.objective: Inspect the repo and create a feature-specific MASTER batch template.
deliverables: Template includes acceptance criteria and approval gates

steps: Patch missing template requirements and rerun this batch.

batches.objective: Implement the requested product or code outcome.
deliverables: Code or docs are updated in canonical repo files

steps: Patch failed implementation checks and rerun this batch.

batches.objective: Run final verification and report completion proof.

steps: Patch failed verification and rerun this batch.

graniteCloudDefault.codingOrder: Granite primary → verify → Aider only-when-needed after ≥2 raw FAIL
